title: TokenEconomizer repository, paper and plugin documentation
summary: Apache 2.0 Microsoft repository (5.2k stars, 317 forks, 8 open issues on 2026-11-08) with a stdlib-only Python package and a hook-based plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and Pi. Paper arXiv:2610.22732 (submitted 2026-10-15) reports 18.4 to 30.9 percent lower mean cost on 277 SWE-Bench tasks across five agent and model pairs, Pass@1 up in 4 of 5, and 6.4 to 21.2 percent on Web-Bench and security audit workloads. Supported versions are narrow (Claude Code 2.1.300 to 2.1.310, Codex 0.153.1 to 0.164.0). Defaults call a model only for the loop guard's judge; micro-skills is off by default.

claims.claim: 18.4 to 30.9 percent lower mean token cost on SWE-Bench across five agent and model combinations, with comparable Pass@1 (authors' own measurement, not independently reproduced).
Three mechanisms: micro-skills injection, evidence-based tool pruning, and a failure-loop guard, all driven from finished sessions in the same repository.
The plugin runs through each agent's own hooks and makes model calls only through the agent's own CLI (haiku by default on Claude Code); it needs no API key of its own.
